entities.name: Zarel Ewine
entities.description: Grand Master of the Arena in Estark, who sought to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City on Dominaria with the Arena.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: Heir of Oor-tael, blinded in one eye as a child, who killed Zarel.

entities.name: Cullinarn
entities.description: Person Zarel held ill will against.

entities.name: House Oor-tael
entities.description: Most powerful House in Kush, destroyed on the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: Attack on Oor-tael by the other Houses and Kuthuman.

events.summary: Zarel convinces Kuthuman to destroy Oor-tael; on the Night of Fire he puts out Garth's left eye.
events.quote: Zarel scraped out the left eye of Garth

events.summary: Zarel becomes Master of the Arena after Kuthuman gains planeswalking.
events.quote: Zarel became the Master of the Arena.

events.summary: Zarel secretly gathers mana, raising taxes and making the Festival bloodier.
events.quote: did so by constantly raising taxes in Estark

events.summary: Zarel destroys the remaining four Houses and kills Varnel Buckara.
Garth returns; Uriah stabs Zarel, Zarel kills Uriah, and Garth kills Zarel.
events.quote: was in turn killed by Garth

relations.quote: was in turn killed by Garth
Zarel responded by stabbing his captain in the heart

relations.note: tasked by him to gather mana
relations.quote: he had been tasked by Kuthuman to gather the mana needed for the planeswalker
